title: ENDEX: Incident Resolved — EOC Closure

fields.resolution: ENDEX. It is 10:30. Halverson High School is cleared and families are being reunified at the Brandt County Fairgrounds Exhibit Hall. The network stays isolated; the domain controller is being rebuilt and backups verified. The ransom question is with the Policy Group, counsel, the risk pool and the FBI; the decision on Wednesday is due by 14:00. The hot wash will begin.
finalState: Halverson High School cleared; reunification at the Fairgrounds.
Network isolated; HUSD-DC01 rebuild and backup verification in progress.
Ransom question with the Policy Group, counsel, the risk pool and the FBI.
fields.hotWashTransition: Thank you, everyone. Put down your phones and radios. We will take ten minutes, then start the hot wash.
fields.hotWashMethod: 3-Up, 3-Down: three things that went well, three things that broke
hotWashQuestions: How did the EOC leadership balance trust in the 05:00 roster with public pressure?
What challenges did the technical team face in verifying system integrity without access to cloud logs?
How effective was the use of manual processes (e.g., paper rosters, physical checks) during recovery?
What role did CISA and external vendors play in enabling recovery, and what delays emerged?
How might the incident have changed the district’s long-term approach to backup verification and ransomware preparedness?

fields.resolution: ENDEX. The EOC lights dim and reset: all screens show 'SYSTEMS STANDBY — RECONNECT IN PROGRESS'. The network status board reads: 'Identity, Firewall, and VPN systems restored; controlled reconnection in progress'. CIRP Form 4 is confirmed signed by Victor Han (CTO) and Kiera Tran (DFIR Lead). The 05:00 offline roster is now officially declared the only trusted source for student accountability. The hot wash will begin immediately.
finalState: Veeam backup from 05:00 restored and hash-verified
No student was left behind; 05:00 roster confirmed accurate
